trips.route_note: Frequent JR Special Rapid or Hankyu/Kintetsu limited express trains run direct from Osaka to central Kyoto in about 30-45 minutes, then use local buses or subway to the temples.
trips.why: Frequent direct trains reach central Kyoto in about 24 minutes, with local buses or subway for the temples.
know: Temples and shrines are spread out, so plan on local buses or subway
Some major sights close in late afternoon
Autumn foliage and spring cherry blossom are the busiest seasons

trips.route_note: Take the JR Sanyo Shinkansen or a direct JR Special Rapid from Osaka to Himeji Station, then walk about 15 minutes to the castle.
trips.tour_query: Himeji Castle day trip from Osaka
trips.why: Shinkansen or direct JR Special Rapid reaches Himeji in about 29 minutes, then the castle is a 15-minute walk.
know: The castle is the main draw and can get crowded
Allow time to walk from the station
Spring cherry blossom is a popular season

bus.via: Osaka Airport to Kobe Sannomiya Station

trips.route_note: JR or Hankyu trains run direct from Osaka to Sannomiya/Kobe in about 25-30 minutes; a local loop bus or ropeway connects to the Kitano and harbor sights.
trips.why: Direct JR or Hankyu trains reach Sannomiya in about 32 minutes, far faster than the bus.
know: Kitano and the harbor are reached by local loop bus or ropeway
Evening harbor views are a highlight

trips.route_note: Take the Keihan line with a change at Chushojima, or JR to Kyoto and a local line to Uji; the town center and Byodo-in are a short walk from the station.
trips.tour_query: Uji tea and Byodo-in day trip from Osaka
trips.why: Trains with one change reach Uji in about 52 minutes, and Byodo-in is a short walk from the station.
know: The town is known for green tea
Some temple halls close in late afternoon
